Title: Confirm organization plan and private repository controls
Acceptance criteria: Purchased plan and required private repository protection features confirmed before transfer

Title: Assign owners and enforce account recovery and 2FA
Acceptance criteria: Two named owners; recovery custody; membership and app access review completed

Title: Reconcile local product changes with source repository
Acceptance criteria: Intended local modified and untracked code reviewed; secrets and generated files excluded; accepted SHA recorded

Title: Transfer existing product repository to HACKWAYS-OTA
Acceptance criteria: Single private destination; Git history and issues preserved; access and links verified; no active duplicate product repo

Title: Create teams and activate CODEOWNERS
Acceptance criteria: Teams have agreed roles; eligible owners installed; real PR requests correct reviews

Title: Require frontend and backend checks on protected branches
Acceptance criteria: PR rules require Hygiene and Go Backend CI and Next.js Frontend CI; image publish checks do not block PRs

Title: Create delivery Project and issue workflow
Acceptance criteria: Existing Projects checked; one linked private Project has agreed fields views labels and owned issues

Title: Validate destination Actions and GHCR packages
Acceptance criteria: PR checks pass; push publishes six images; source SHA and host private package pull access verified

Title: Configure public frontend origin build variables
Acceptance criteria: Built images contain intended public origins and relative browser API paths; no localhost fallback in production navigation

Title: Repair production Compose YAML indentation
Acceptance criteria: Malformed core and organizer API environment entries fixed; docker compose config --quiet succeeds with sanitized validation inputs

Title: Establish production release evidence and deployment trigger
Acceptance criteria: Actual live branch SHA image digests migration version and release owner recorded; correct signed workflow_run webhook verified

Title: Confirm database topology and backup restore procedure
Acceptance criteria: Actual provider/version recorded; backup script matches topology; isolated restore succeeds; no destructive production restore

Title: Verify Azure uploads and ACS delivery with authorized credentials
Acceptance criteria: Real SAS upload completion and provider operation evidence verified; failed sends and retries observable

Title: Establish secrets and external access inventory
Acceptance criteria: Vault and runtime access plus registry DNS registrar mailbox identities have owners backups and rotation procedures; no values in issues

Title: Document schema-compatible rollback and retention of release images
Acceptance criteria: Previous known-good six-image release retained; migration compatibility reviewed; rollback evidence recorded

Title: Assign policy and licensing decisions
Acceptance criteria: Legal operator/address retention age policy and licensing position confirmed; no fabricated legal commitments

Title: Complete public page layout and browser review
Acceptance criteria: Website-style page layouts reviewed at desktop/mobile sizes; no documentation sidebars or generated hash navigation; accessibility confirmed
